options.description: The columns the view is drawn in, the gutter included.
options.name: width

options.description: The class every part is named from: `<class>` on a run, `<class>-row` on a row, `<class>-gutter` on a gutter and `<class>-view` on the whole. Defaults to `sigil-code`.
options.name: class

options.description: The number of the first line, for an excerpt. Defaults to 1. Only read where there is a gutter.
options.name: firstLine

options.description: Whether each line is numbered, in a gutter that is as wide as the last number. Defaults to `false`.
options.name: gutter

options.description: Says which stretches of the code are which tokens: `highlightCode()` from `@ttylabs/sigil/components/highlight` is one. Called once, with the whole text, so a block comment that begins on one line and ends on another is one span. A hook that throws throws out of `codeView()`, a span out of range is clipped, and a token no class can carry is refused with a `PromptError` -- `diff()`'s three answers.
options.name: highlight

options.description: The language, handed to `highlight` as its second argument.
options.name: lang

options.description: The class a run with no token carries beside `class`, for an app that wants the code it did not highlight drawn in a role. Defaults to none: the plain foreground.
options.name: plain

options.description: Properties for the box the rows are in.
options.name: props

options.description: How many columns a tab goes to the next multiple of. Defaults to 4. A tab is drawn as spaces, since a terminal has no tab stops of its own to count on.
options.name: tabSize

options.description: The token of each code unit of the text, where the caller already has them. Takes the place of `highlight`.
options.name: tokens

options.description: What a line too long for the width does. `'cut'` ends it at the edge, as a pager shows code; `'fold'` carries it onto the next row at a grapheme boundary. Defaults to `'cut'`.
options.name: wrap

api.signature: function codeView(code: string, opts: CodeViewOptions): Element

registryDescription: A code view: highlighted lines with an optional gutter of line numbers, cut or folded to a width
